title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content: 江南三中的电铃如往常般准时响起，却在林宇耳中显得格外刺耳。金属桌面残留的汗渍被试卷边缘刮起的风拂干，露出蜿蜒的水痕，宛如某种神秘的古老图腾。他深吸一口气，缓缓拆开密封袋，那一瞬间，时间仿佛凝固。映入眼帘的并非熟悉的高考模拟题型，而是三道如同天书般的矩阵方程，字符扭曲盘旋，仿佛是来自异世界的文字。林宇的瞳孔骤然收缩，握笔的指尖微微发颤。压轴页附着的cad图纸上，“矢量喷口偏转角度”几个字刺得他眼睛生疼，图纸上复杂的线条交织成一张无形的大网，将他困在其中。“这……这怎么可能？”林宇的喉结上下滚动，喃喃自语。他下意识地抬头望向教室前方的监考老师老王，却发现对方正百无聊赖地打哈欠。老王领带夹上的金属装饰在阳光下折射出一道光斑，诡异的是，这光斑竟在图纸上拼凑出完整的引擎剖面图。林宇揉了揉眼睛，以为是自己出现了幻觉，但光斑依旧清晰地投射在那里，仿佛在向他诉说着什么不为人知的秘密。周围的同学早已奋笔疾书，沙沙的书写声在寂静的教室里回荡，如同无数春蚕啃食桑叶。而林宇却感觉自己仿佛置身于另一个世界，与周围的一切格格不入。他的大脑飞速运转，试图从记忆中搜索出任何与这些题目相关的知识，然而，脑海中一片空白。铅笔尖在“材料应力系数”处突然断裂，石墨粉如黑色的精灵般在试卷上聚成微型漩涡，那形状酷似某种未知的能量循环符号。林宇盯着这诡异的漩涡，心跳不由自主地加快。他隐约觉得，这看似偶然的铅笔断裂，背后似乎隐藏着某种必然。就在这时，前排的赵天雷突然咳嗽了一声，那声音在林宇听来格外刺耳。他抬头望去，只见赵天雷嘴角勾起一抹若有若无的冷笑，眼神中充满了挑衅和得意。林宇心中一紧，突然意识到这一切或许并非巧合。联想到之前赵天雷的种种异常举动，那个赌约，还有他鞋底粘着的碎纸，林宇的手心沁出了冷汗。“冷静，一定要冷静。”林宇在心中不断告诫自己。他强迫自己深呼吸，努力平复内心的慌乱。然而，当他再次低头看向试卷时，那些陌生的公式和符号仿佛变成了活物，在试卷上肆意跳动，嘲笑他的无能为力。时间一分一秒地流逝，林宇的焦虑逐渐转化为绝望。就在他几乎要放弃的时候，一个念头突然闪过脑海：“既然这不是普通的试卷，或许不能用常规的方法来解答。”他想起自己平时对量子物理的热爱和钻研，虽然那些知识对于高考来说可能有些超前，但此刻，或许是他唯一的希望。林宇闭上眼睛，开始在脑海中构建量子物理的知识体系。他试图将那些看似毫无关联的矩阵方程与量子力学中的理论联系起来。渐渐地，他发现这些方程中似乎蕴含着某种量子纠缠的原理，而图纸上的矢量喷口设计，或许与量子场的操控有关。这个发现让林宇心中燃起了一丝希望之火。他重新拿起笔，开始在草稿纸上推演起来。然而，随着推演的深入，新的问题又接踵而至。一些关键的数据和参数在他的知识储备中根本找不到对应的内容，仿佛这些题目是专门为了难倒他而设计的。正当林宇陷入困境时，他突然注意到试卷边缘的一些细微痕迹。那些痕迹看起来像是被某种化学试剂处理过，隐隐约约透出一些不同于试卷本身的颜色。林宇心中一动，难道这其中隐藏着什么关键信息？他小心翼翼地将试卷举到阳光下，仔细观察那些痕迹。果然，在特定的角度下，一些模糊的文字和数字显现了出来。这些信息虽然残缺不全，但却为他的推演提供了重要的线索。林宇仿佛在黑暗中找到了一丝光明，兴奋地加快了书写的速度。然而，就在他全神贯注地答题时，教室的门突然被猛地推开。几个穿着黑色西装的人快步走了进来，他们的眼神冷峻，身上散发着一种令人不寒而栗的气息。教室里的空气瞬间凝固，所有同学都停下了手中的笔，惊恐地看着这些不速之客。为首的男子径直走到林宇的课桌前，他的目光如鹰隼般扫过林宇的试卷，然后冷冷地说道：“林宇同学，请跟我们走一趟。”林宇愣住了，手中的笔“啪嗒”一声掉在地上。他看着眼前这些陌生人，心中充满了疑惑和恐惧：“你们是谁？为什么找我？”“少废话，到了地方你就知道了。”男子不耐烦地说道，语气中带着不容置疑的威严。林宇无助地看向周围的同学，希望能得到一些帮助。然而，同学们都纷纷避开他的目光，仿佛他是一个瘟神。赵天雷的脸上则露出了幸灾乐祸的笑容，那笑容让林宇感到一阵心寒。在众人的注视下，林宇被这些人带出了教室。走廊里，阳光透过窗户洒在地面上，形成一片片斑驳的光影。然而，此刻的林宇却感觉不到一丝温暖，他的心中充满了迷茫和不安。他不知道等待自己的将是什么，也不知道这一切究竟是怎么回事。当他走出教学楼的那一刻，一辆黑色的轿车停在了他的面前。车门打开，林宇被示意上车。车内的气氛压抑得让人喘不过气来，林宇坐在座位上，双手紧紧地握在一起，手心里全是汗水。轿车缓缓启动，向着未知的方向驶去。透过车窗，林宇看着熟悉的校园渐渐远去，心中涌起一股复杂的情绪。他知道，自己的生活从此将发生翻天覆地的变化，而这一切，都源于那张异常的试卷。
content_en: The bell of Jiangnan No. 3 Middle School rang on time as usual, but it sounded particularly harsh to Lin Yu's ears.The remaining sweat stains on the metal tabletop were blown away by the wind blowing from the edge of the test paper, revealing winding water marks, like some mysterious ancient totem.He took a deep breath and slowly opened the sealed bag. At that moment, time seemed to freeze.What came into view was not the familiar college entrance examination simulation questions, but three matrix equations that looked like a heavenly book. The characters were twisted and circling, as if they were words from another world.Lin Yu's pupils suddenly shrank, and the fingertips holding the pen trembled slightly.On the CAD drawing attached to the finale page, the words "vector nozzle deflection angle" stung his eyes. The complex lines on the drawing intertwined into an invisible network, trapping him in it."This...how is this possible?" Lin Yu muttered to himself as his Adam's apple rolled up and down.He subconsciously looked up at the invigilator Lao Wang at the front of the classroom, only to find that he was yawning out of boredom.The metal decoration on Lao Wang's tie clip refracted a spot of light in the sun. Strangely, this spot of light actually pieced together a complete cross-section of the engine on the drawing.Lin Yu rubbed his eyes, thinking he was hallucinating, but the light spot was still clearly projected there, as if telling him some unknown secret.The surrounding students were already writing furiously, and the rustling sound of writing echoed in the silent classroom, like countless spring silkworms eating mulberry leaves.But Lin Yu felt as if he was in another world, incompatible with everything around him.His brain was working rapidly, trying to search out any knowledge related to these topics from his memory, but his mind went blank.The tip of the pencil suddenly broke at the "material stress coefficient", and the graphite powder gathered on the test paper like black elves to form micro vortices. The shape resembled some unknown energy cycle symbol.Lin Yu stared at this strange whirlpool, his heart beating faster involuntarily.He vaguely felt that there seemed to be some kind of necessity hidden behind this seemingly accidental pencil break.At this moment, Zhao Tianlei in the front row suddenly coughed, and the sound was particularly harsh to Lin Yu's ears.He looked up and saw a faint sneer on Zhao Tianlei's lips, his eyes full of provocation and pride.Lin Yu's heart tightened, and he suddenly realized that all this might not be a coincidence.Thinking of Zhao Tianlei's various abnormal behaviors before, the bet, and the shredded paper stuck to the soles of his shoes, Lin Yu's palms broke into cold sweat."Calm down, you must calm down." Lin Yu kept warning himself in his heart.He forced himself to take a deep breath, trying to calm his inner panic.However, when he looked down at the test paper again, those unfamiliar formulas and symbols seemed to have become living creatures, jumping wildly on the test paper, mocking his powerlessness.As time passed by, Lin Yu's anxiety gradually turned into despair.Just when he was about to give up, a thought suddenly flashed through his mind: "Since this is not an ordinary test paper, maybe it cannot be answered using conventional methods." He thought of his usual love and study of quantum physics. Although that knowledge may be a bit advanced for the college entrance examination, at this moment, it may be his only hope.Lin Yu closed his eyes and began to construct a knowledge system of quantum physics in his mind.He tried to connect seemingly unrelated matrix equations to theories in quantum mechanics.Gradually, he discovered that these equations seemed to contain some kind of quantum entanglement principle, and the vector nozzle design on the drawings might be related to the manipulation of quantum fields.This discovery ignited a glimmer of hope in Lin Yu's heart.He picked up the pen again and began to deduce on the scratch paper.However, as the deduction progressed, new problems emerged one after another.Some key data and parameters had no corresponding content in his knowledge reserve, as if these questions were specially designed to stump him.Just when Lin Yu was in trouble, he suddenly noticed some subtle marks on the edge of the test paper.Those traces looked like they had been treated with some kind of chemical reagent, and they vaguely revealed some colors that were different from the test paper itself.Lin Yu's heart moved. Is there any key information hidden in this?He carefully held the test paper up to the sun and carefully observed the marks.Sure enough, at a specific angle, some vague words and numbers appeared.Although this information is incomplete, it provides important clues for his deduction.Lin Yu seemed to have found a glimmer of light in the darkness, and excitedly accelerated his writing speed.However, just as he was concentrating on answering the questions, the classroom door was suddenly pushed open.Several people in black suits walked in quickly, their eyes were cold and they exuded a chilling aura.The air in the classroom froze instantly, and all the students stopped writing and looked at these uninvited guests in horror.The leading man walked straight to Lin Yu's desk. His eyes swept over Lin Yu's test paper like a hawk, and then said coldly: "Classmate Lin Yu, please come with us." Lin Yu was stunned, and the pen in his hand fell to the ground with a "clack".He looked at the strangers in front of him, and his heart was full of doubts and fears: "Who are you? Why are you looking for me?" "Stop talking nonsense, you will know when you get there." The man said impatiently, with unquestionable majesty in his tone.Lin Yu looked helplessly at the classmates around him, hoping to get some help.However, the classmates all avoided his gaze, as if he was a god of plague.Zhao Tianlei's face showed a gloating smile, which made Lin Yu feel chilled.Under the gaze of everyone, Lin Yu was taken out of the classroom by these people.In the corridor, sunlight shines on the ground through the windows, forming patches of mottled light and shadow.However, Lin Yu could not feel any warmth at this moment, and his heart was full of confusion and uneasiness.He didn't know what was waiting for him, nor what was going on.The moment he walked out of the teaching building, a black car stopped in front of him.The car door opened and Lin Yu was motioned to get in the car.The atmosphere in the car was so oppressive that it made people breathless. Lin Yu sat on the seat, holding his hands tightly together, and his palms were covered with sweat.The car started slowly and drove towards an unknown direction.Through the car window, Lin Yu watched the familiar campus gradually fade away, feeling a surge of complicated emotions in his heart.He knew that his life would undergo earth-shaking changes from now on, and all of this stemmed from that abnormal test paper.
